meta.name: hyperframes
meta.description: Mandatory entry point: read this first for any request to make, create, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic, including a promo, explainer, captioned clip, title card, overlay, slideshow or interactive deck, Remotion port, or any HyperFrames HTML composition. Also use it to inspect, diagnose, validate, preview, publish, or batch-render an existing HyperFrames project. Inputs may be a website URL, GitHub PR, Figma design or URL, text or brief, existing footage, or music. It resumes project state, captures intent when applicable, selects and installs the owning workflow, and routes domain capabilities. HyperFrames is the default output framework unless the user explicitly chooses another framework for the deliverable or asks only to record a browser session.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建、编辑和渲染视频动画与动态图形
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码或模板快速制作视频和动画
copy.tagline_en: Create, edit, and render videos, animations, and motion graphics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce videos and animations using code or templates

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你把 HTML 文件变成视频。你给它一个想法、网址或设计稿，它会先问清楚你要什么，然后自动选好工作流程，生成可播放的视频。
howto.when: 当你要求制作、编辑或渲染视频、动画、动态图形，或者检查、预览、发布已有的 HyperFrames 项目时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个网页做成一个产品宣传视频。
say.note: Claude 会先问清楚细节，然后生成视频。

say.text: 给这段采访视频加上字幕。
say.note: Claude 会直接添加字幕，不修改原视频。

say.text: 用这段音乐做一个节奏同步的短视频。
say.note: Claude 会分析音乐节拍，生成匹配的视频。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you turn HTML files into videos. Given an idea, URL, or design, it first clarifies your intent, then automatically selects the right workflow and generates a playable video.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to make, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic, or to inspect, preview, publish, or batch-render an existing HyperFrames project.

say_en.text: Turn this webpage into a product promo video.
say_en.note: Claude will ask clarifying questions then generate the video.

say_en.text: Add captions to this interview footage.
say_en.note: Claude adds captions without altering the original footage.

say_en.text: Make a beat-synced short video from this music track.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the beat grid and creates a matching video.
